question: ‘My Days’ is an autobiography written by whom among the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Narayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• R.K. Narayan is the author of the autobiography "My Days."
 
• This insightful memoir delves into the life and experiences of this renowned Indian writer, offering readers a glimpse into his childhood, his journey as a writer, and his reflections on the world around him.
 
• Narayan is well-known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi. "My Days" provides a personal account of the influences and inspirations that shaped his literary career.
 
• It offers valuable insights into the evolution of Indian English literature and the socio-cultural context of the time.
